system.unidentifiedDesc: An muzzle for covering a creatures mouth.
system.description: This item is a device of leather straps with metal buckles and may be fastened over the mouth of any animal or monster that has a bite attack. It will magically expand or contract to fit the creature, and the victim can breathe but cannot bite (or talk) while wearing the muzzle. The muzzle will lock in place with a command word (treat as a wizard lock by a 15th level caster) and will unlock and fall off with a second command. The muzzle can be commanded as often as desired.
